title: Geometry Unit 2 Pretest
purpose: Diagnostic assessment for prior knowledge, readiness, and acceleration eligibility.

primaryStandards.description: I can describe transformations and write coordinate rules for images and preimages.
I can determine whether a transformation preserves distance.
I can identify transformation sequences that map figures onto themselves or other figures.
I can identify reflection, rotation, and translation symmetry in geometric figures.
I can draw transformed figures on a coordinate plane after a sequence of transformations.
I can use rigid transformations to justify that two figures are congruent.
I can prove triangle congruence or similarity using valid triangle criteria.
I can justify triangle congruence criteria using rigid transformations.
